messages:
tara: FYI started a focused shadow for v3-int4-lite on seq2seq long-summary workload. latency looks great but we saw an unexpected drop on ROUGE-L for documents > 10k chars. opening thread to capture gate rules.
noah: do we have slice breakdowns? longdocs, bullet-list, and code-embedded?
tara: yes — drop concentrated in longdocs narrative and doc+table mixes. sample link: https://internal.redwood/samples/4190012345-longdocs
deepa: curious if this is quant noise vs cache evaporation. warmup hit-rate for longctx?
tara: warmup hits variant 0.58 vs control 0.84. eviction rate higher after 45s idle. we changed kv-ttl to 45s to save mem on this build.
ops-bot: deploybot: shadow job 4190012400 started for v3-int4-lite region-eu-central
noah: propose an "entropy-watchdog" gate: combine ROUGE-L delta, exact-match for structured sections, and JS divergence on token distributions. auto-fallback only if all three cross thresholds.
tara: agree. also require min_samples 2k and affected cohort >2% traffic. no auto-fallback if latency SLO (tail) regresses.
deepa: add stabilization: require 2 consecutive eval windows (10m each) and bootstrap CI failure (95% CI doesn't include zero). if auto-fallback triggered notify #oncall and create rollback ticket.
tara: draft gate YAML: 
```yaml
gate:
  name: entropy-watchdog-longdocs
  windows: 2
  metrics:
    - name: ROUGE-L
      comparator: delta_pct
      threshold: -3.5
      min_samples: 2000
    - name: JS-token
      comparator: delta
      threshold: 0.08
    - name: EM-structured
      comparator: delta_pct
      threshold: -2.0
  cohort_filter:
    slices: ["longdoc/narrative", "longdoc/table-mix"]
    min_traffic_pct: 2
  safety:
    require_latency_ok: true
    latency_metric: p99
    latency_margin_ms: 20
  action:
    on_violation: staged_rollback
    staged_steps: ["drain-variant", "stop-shadow", "alert-oncall"]
    cooldown_after_manual_promote: 1h
```
noah: looks good. small tweak: use normalized ROUGE (length-adjusted) and prefer median-based delta to avoid skew from outliers.
deepa: +1. also log raw token entropy per-slice to perf dashboard.
eval-bot: eval-bot: first window complete -> ROUGE-L delta -4.1% (bootstrap CI 95% lower bound -3.6%), JS-token +0.09, EM-structured -1.8%, affected slices weight 2.7%
tara: CI lower bound crosses threshold; JS above threshold. EM slightly under -> two of three metrics violate, but staging rule requires all three. we still hit safety net criteria to pause auto-promote.
noah: since staged condition met, do manual inspect. @deepa can you run focused microshadow with kv-ttl 90s to test warmup hypothesis?
deepa: on it. scheduling microshadow 50k synthetic longdocs for tonight.
tara: documenting gate config in canary repo and adding alert routing. will follow up with post-eval notes.
